info.name: TaskFlow API (week 3)
info.description: NestJS + Prisma API. Requires the database (docker compose up -d --wait) and the app (npm run start:dev) to be running. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, starting with the Auth folder: it registers a fresh user and saves a token, which every other request sends as a Bearer token (set on the collection). The Projects, Tasks and Comments folders clean up after themselves; registered users stay in the database.
